Heating

Wood or electric, your call.

Every tub in the range is offered both ways. Pick the one that fits how you like to unwind.

Wood-fired
Heated by a wood-burning stove. Light it, feed it, and the water warms while you wait.
Electric
Heated electrically, so the water is ready whenever you are.
Hybrid
Both on one tub. Fire it up for the ritual, switch to electric for the everyday.
In the details

The finer points, done properly.

Stove door

A viewing window so you can watch the fire without lifting a thing.

Chimney guard

A cut steel sleeve around the flue, so hands stay clear of the heat.

Timber steps

Curved to sit snug against the tub, for an easy way in and out.

Materials

Timber, steel and nothing to hide.

Staves held tight in stainless bands, fittings set flush to the wood. Honest materials that look better the longer they live outside.

After dark

Lanterns on, lid off.

A Vale is at its best when the day is done. Set it on a deck, a gravel bed or a patio and let the garden do the rest.

Questions

Good to know.

Do your prices include VAT?

No. Every price we show is plus VAT, and we always say so.

Is delivery and installation included?

Delivery and installation are priced separately, because every site is different. We work it out for your garden.

Can I have wood-fired or electric?

Yes. Each tub in the range comes wood-fired or electric, and there are hybrid options too.

Where can I see one?

Come and find us at the Land, Leisure and Tourism Show at the NEC, 4 to 5 November 2026, stand LLT455.
